entry.title: Douglas County Fair Heads Into Final Two Days With Music, Livestock Auction And Family Activities
entry.summary: The Douglas County Fair heads into its final two days Friday with Tone Loc, the annual 4-H and FFA Livestock Auction, carnival rides, live music, exhibits and special admission offers for kids, teens and fairgoers who “Dress a Vegetable.”

entry.title: North Umpqua Steelhead Fishing To Close Aug. 10 Amid Low Wild Returns
entry.summary: Steelhead fishing on the North Umpqua River will close Aug. 10 through Nov. 30 after fewer than 1,000 wild summer steelhead passed Winchester Dam. ODFW says low returns, warm water and low river flows prompted the emergency closure.

entry.title: Douglas County Fair stays busy despite smoky conditions
entry.summary: Despite smoky, hot conditions, the Douglas County Fair is still drawing crowds, but fairgoers, animals, and workers are being urged to stay hydrated, monitor air quality, and take precautions as first responders report some heat-related incidents.

entry.title: Coos Bay clinic owner pleads guilty to $2M healthcare fraud
entry.summary: A Coos Bay man admitted to running a years-long scheme that defrauded federal health programs and private insurers out of more than $2 million through his sleep study testing company.

entry.title: Fire Danger Raised To ‘Very High’ On Umpqua National Forest
entry.summary: Fire danger has increased to “very high” across the Umpqua National Forest as hotter, drier conditions settle in. Stage 2 restrictions remain in effect, limiting campfires, chainsaw use, off-road travel, smoking, welding and other activities.

entry.title: Roseburg Ties Year’s High At 99, Still Awaits First 100-Degree Day
entry.summary: Roseburg reached 99 degrees Wednesday, tying the city’s hottest temperature of 2026. The same high was recorded June 15, meaning Roseburg has now fallen one degree short of its first triple-digit day twice this year.
